# Estate of Lokken v. UnitedHealth Group (nH Predict)

- Citation: Estate of Gene B. Lokken v. UnitedHealth Group, Inc., No. 0:23-cv-03514 (D. Minn.). Docket: https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/68006832/estate-of-gene-b-lokken-the-v-unitedhealth-group-inc/ ; tracker: https://litigationtracker.law.georgetown.edu/litigation/estate-of-gene-b-lokken-the-et-al-v-unitedhealth-group-inc-et-al/
- Tier: 3 (read through law-firm and tracker summaries, not the filings)
- Key points: class action alleging UnitedHealth used the nH Predict algorithm to end MA post-acute coverage, against plan materials saying clinicians decide. The complaint alleges over 90% of denials reversed on appeal (an allegation, not a finding). Motion to dismiss granted in part; breach of contract and good-faith claims proceed. A March 2026 order compelled records on nH Predict's development and oversight. Trial-ready date: September 2027.
- Limits: allegations unproven; summaries only.
